## 简体中文

### Esse 1.1.0-beta.9

- 新增 Google Gemini 官方生图：在“高级设置 → Provider → 添加 → Google Gemini · 官方”中填写自己的 Google API Key 即可保存使用，无需 Esse Key。接口地址、原生格式和默认模型已预填；连接测试只读取模型列表。
- 支持原始参考图、模型允许的宽高比例和分辨率，并在提交前检查格式、数量和请求大小。不同模型的能力分别限制；价格保持未知，以 Google 实际账单为准。
- 生成与连接测试均拒绝重定向，避免转发 Google Key。同一响应中的全部最终图片会保存并关联到原任务，其余图片显示为“同次生成结果”，支持逐张查看、修改、删除、批次合并和中断后取回。
- 通过虚构 Key、离线响应和本地重定向夹具验证请求结构、结果保存及恢复；未使用真实 Google Key 提交付费请求。Google 项目权限、真实生成图片的像素、参考图效果及实际账单未验收；实体 Apple Silicon Mac 安装流程尚未验收。

[完整变更记录](https://github.com/renoir1220/esse-private/compare/v1.1.0-beta.8...v1.1.0-beta.9)

## English

### Esse 1.1.0-beta.9

- Adds official Google Gemini image generation. Open Advanced settings → Provider → Add → Google Gemini · Official and save your Google API key; no Esse Key is required. The API URL, native format and default model are prefilled. Connection testing only reads the model list.
- Supports original reference images, model-specific aspect ratios and resolutions, with local checks for formats, counts and request size before submission. Model capabilities are limited individually. Prices remain unknown and follow the actual Google bill.
- Generation and connection testing reject redirects to prevent forwarding the Google key. Every final image in one response is saved under the original task; additional images are labeled as same-call results and support individual viewing, modification, deletion, batch merge and recovery after interruption.
- Request structure, output persistence and recovery were tested with fictional keys, offline responses and local redirect fixtures. No paid request using a real Google key was submitted. Google project permissions, actual generated pixels, reference-image effects and billing remain unverified, as does installation through the physical Apple Silicon Mac user flow.

[Full changelog](https://github.com/renoir1220/esse-private/compare/v1.1.0-beta.8...v1.1.0-beta.9)
